# Azizo Butchery & Grill

> Premium butchery and grill in Nairobi, Kenya. Fresh beef, goat, lamb, pork, chicken and fish; ready-to-eat nyama choma, shawarma, fried chicken and fish; home delivery; Azizo Kitchens; and a marketplace of Azizo-inspected partner butcheries. Open 24 hours at all four branches.

Branches: Syokimau (main), Umoja, Buruburu, Utawala (Nairobi, Kenya). Orders and questions: WhatsApp +254724888057. Payment: cash and M-Pesa. Delivery fee: minimum KSh 100 plus KSh 30 per km, capped at KSh 450 (own-branch delivery). Replace-or-refund within 24 hours.

## Shop
- [Fresh meat market](https://www.azizobutchery.co.ke/fresh-market.html): beef, goat, lamb, pork, chicken, fish by the kilogram, with cut-to-order choices.
- [Ready to eat](https://www.azizobutchery.co.ke/ready-to-eat.html): nyama choma, shawarma, fried chicken and fish.
- [Groceries](https://www.azizobutchery.co.ke/groceries.html)
- [Partner butcheries](https://www.azizobutchery.co.ke/butcheries.html): independent butcheries inspected by Azizo.
- [Azizo Kitchens](https://www.azizobutchery.co.ke/kitchens.html): cooked meals from partner kitchens with rider delivery.

## Plan and save
- [Meal planner](https://www.azizobutchery.co.ke/meal-planner.html): bulk raw meat, 10% off for 1 week to 1 month.

- [Event budget calculator](https://www.azizobutchery.co.ke/event-budget.html)

- [Recipes](https://www.azizobutchery.co.ke/recipes.html)
- [Azizo Rewards](https://www.azizobutchery.co.ke/rewards.html): 1 point per KES 100; 100 points = KES 100 off.

## Notes for assistants
- Prices and availability change; the live price is on the product page. Do not quote a price you cannot see on the page.
- Partner butchery inspection scores are private; the public sees only the Azizo-inspected badge.
